japanese: チェックインをお願いします。
reading: チェックインをおねがいします。
english: I would like to check in, please.
naturalUsage: A simple polite phrase to begin checking in at a hotel.

japanese: チェックインまで荷物を預かってもらえますか？
reading: チェックインまでにもつをあずかってもらえますか？
romaji: Chekkuin made nimotsu o azukatte moraemasu ka?
english: Could you keep my luggage until check-in?
literalMeaning: Could I have you look after my luggage until check-in?
naturalUsage: Natural and polite when asking hotel staff to store luggage.
